title: fix(spec): serve a field's translated help on its authored inlineHelpText
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9BPVregzaDKr59ydSYbvwJw)_

Fixes #29153

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：服务端翻译对象时，字段帮助的译文除了照旧写到 `description`，还写到字段自己填写的 `inlineHelpText` 上。
- 为什么改：控制台先显示 `inlineHelpText`，以前译文只写在 `description`，所以填了 `inlineHelpText` 的字段在任何语言下都显示英文原文（如 showcase 的「线索评分」）。
- 风险与回滚：只改翻译后的读出结果，不改作者能写什么；没填 `inlineHelpText` 的字段不变，租户改过的文本照旧保留。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` 的 `translateField` 帮助分支，再看同文件 `translateObject` 文档块，最后看新测试块。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`，预期全部通过，含 `lead_score` 在 zh-CN 下的 `inlineHelpText` 为「由评分规则计算,不可手动编辑。」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`translateObject` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) serves the bundle's `objects.OBJECT.fields.FIELD.help` entry on the field's own `inlineHelpText` when the field authors a non-empty one, as well as on `description` (unchanged). The new slot follows the same per-slot packaged-base divergence rule (`valueOverridesPackagedBase`, ADR-0029 D9.2a) that already guards `description`; no second comparison was added. The docblock that said help was "not served on `inlineHelpText` either, which the extractor never reads" is corrected: the extractor has read `inlineHelpText` since #25683.

No new key, no second fold, and nothing is ever served on `help`. `ui/packages/fields` and `packages/cli` are untouched.

### The matrix (one derivation, three places)

| Field authors | Extractor scaffolds `help` from | Resolver serves translation on | Console draws (`inlineHelpText \|\| description`) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `inlineHelpText` only | `inlineHelpText` | `inlineHelpText` + `description` | translated `inlineHelpText` |
| `inlineHelpText` + `description` | `inlineHelpText` | `inlineHelpText` + `description` | translated `inlineHelpText` |
| `description` only | `description` | `description` (no `inlineHelpText` key added) | translated `description` |
| `inlineHelpText: ''` + `description` | nothing: the `??` chain stops at `''` and `pushOptional` scaffolds no seed for it (see Acceptance notes) | an entry, when present, on `description`; the empty `inlineHelpText` stays empty | `description` |
| `help` | `help` | nothing on `help` | n/a: `FieldSchema` refuses `help` (`unrecognized_keys`, "Did you mean `help` → `inlineHelpText`?"), so no stored field carries it |

### Forced test edits

- `i18n-resolver.test.ts`, describe "a field's translated help is served on `description`": the `phone` fixture's bundle entries now carry what the extractor actually writes for a field authoring `inlineHelpText` (its `inlineHelpText` text, not its `description`), and the test that pinned "`inlineHelpText` is untouched" now pins the translation on both slots. Two sibling assertions on `phone.description` follow the new fixture string.

## Tests

New describe block "a field's translated help reaches the slot the console draws first": the showcase `lead_score` case (zh-CN serves 由评分规则计算,不可手动编辑。 on `inlineHelpText`, parses with no unrecognized key), CONTROL for the source locale, CONTROL for a locale with no `help` entry, never another field's entry, no `inlineHelpText` gained by a field without one, the empty-string case, divergence kept in every locale through `translateMetadataDocument`, an extension field counting as diverged, no packaged base, and no input mutation.

<details><summary>Readings (head e1451dc0, tree objectstack-ai/objectstack)</summary>

- `@objectstack/spec` test: Test Files 790 passed (790), Tests 23377 passed, 1 todo. typecheck exit 0.
- `@objectstack/spec` build + `check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". No regenerated file changed.
- Consumers (downstream of the served read): `@objectstack/rest` full suite, Test Files 367 passed (367), Tests 6963 passed, 332 skipped. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` full suite, Test Files 298 passed, 4 skipped. `@objectstack/cli` unit `test/i18n-extract-inline-help-text.test.ts` 6/6. `@objectstack/objectql` `src/engine-formula-option-label.test.ts` 7/7. `ui/` `packages/fields/src/__tests__/fieldHelpText-12213.test.tsx` 5/5 (run from `ui/`).
- Ablation: `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the `next.inlineHelpText = translatedHelp;` line (anchor 1 → 0, blob 0241a7c5ab2e → 5fc0e733d89c); `i18n-resolver.test.ts` went red, 3 failed / 377 passed (the `phone` both-slots test, the `lead_score` test, the no-packaged-base test). Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- When a field authors both `inlineHelpText` and a different `description`, the entry is the translation of `inlineHelpText` (the extractor's source), and `description` is also served that text. That was already the served behaviour before this PR; the seat's ruling keeps it ("keeps serving `description` as today"). It is recorded in the report's open questions.
- The extractor's `help ?? inlineHelpText ?? description` stops at an authored `inlineHelpText: ''`, so `os i18n extract` scaffolds no `help` entry for such a field, while the console (`||`) draws its `description`. That half is `packages/cli`, outside this card's file surface; it is reported to the seat as a finding, not fixed here. The resolver side of that row is pinned (an entry, when one exists, lands on `description` and the empty `inlineHelpText` stays empty).

## Verification

Derived gate list (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`) run locally at the final head; per-command exits are in the os-dev-report on the card. Repo-wide scans (`pnpm lint`, the full `check:*` farm) are CI's.
